name: Iri
title: Descendant of Benjamin
summary: Iri was a son of Bela and a grandson of Benjamin, the youngest son of Jacob. He is mentioned in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles as one of the heads of the families in the tribe of Benjamin. He was among the registered warriors of the tribe of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Benjamin's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Iri is listed as one of the five sons of Bela, son of Benjamin, in the genealogical record in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Registered as a family head
keyEvents.description: Iri was registered among the heads of the families in the tribe of Benjamin, who were skilled warriors.

keyEvents.title: Part of the tribe of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: As a descendant of Benjamin, Jacob's youngest son with Rachel, Iri belonged to one of Israel's twelve tribes.

keyEvents.title: Counted among the warriors
keyEvents.description: Iri's family was counted among the fighting men of the tribe of Benjamin, which totaled 22,034 men.
